notes: Readers and writers as std::io wrappers; ErrTimeout is the unit type ErrTimeout (ERR_TIMEOUT, is_err_timeout) converting to an io::Error of kind TimedOut. The loggers write through rust_stdlib::log::printf. Behaviour is compared with Go by tools/testing_check.py (wrapper scripts and TestReader verdicts over deliberately broken readers).

DataErrReader.note: Go returns the final data together with the error in one call. Rust's Read returns a count or an error, so the reader keeps Go's one-read look-ahead and delivers the error from the next call; the sequence of underlying reads is Go's.

TestReader.note: Go discovers io.Seeker and io.ReaderAt by type assertion; here the reader implements the TestableReader trait (as_seek, as_read_at), which std readers, bytes/strings readers, SectionReader, Cursor and fs files already do. Checks and messages are Go's.
